When the effect of the mediator depends on the treatment, the outcome model
carries a `treatment * mediator` term and the effect splits into four parts.
Part of the [Models](models.html) collection.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Structure** | X to M to Y, with an X by M term in the outcome model |
| **Class returned** | `InteractionMediationData` |
| **Routes** | `fit_mediation()` (glm or `regmedint` engine), `extract_mediation()` on `lm`/`glm` or lavaan |
| **Needs** | Gaussian identity-link models and a reference mediator level `m_star` |

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(medfit)
library(generics)
```

## Fit it

Write the product in the outcome formula; medfit recognizes it and returns the
four-way class. `m_star` is the mediator level at which the controlled direct
effect is evaluated (default 0).

```{r}
#| label: fit
fit <- fit_mediation(
  outcome_int ~ treatment * mediator1 + covariate1 + covariate2,
  mediator1 ~ treatment + covariate1 + covariate2,
  data = mediation_demo, treatment = "treatment", mediator = "mediator1",
  m_star = 0
)
class(fit)[1]
decompose(fit)
```

## The four parts

| Part | Name | Reads as |
|---|---|---|
| `cde` | controlled direct effect | effect of the treatment with the mediator held at `m_star` |
| `int_ref` | reference interaction | interaction due to the mediator's level without the treatment |
| `int_med` | mediated interaction | interaction that operates through the treatment's effect on the mediator |
| `pie` | pure indirect effect | effect through the mediator with no interaction |

```{r}
#| label: sums
parts <- decompose(fit)
c(nde = unname(parts["cde"] + parts["int_ref"]),
  nie = unname(parts["int_med"] + parts["pie"]),
  total = unname(sum(parts[c("cde", "int_ref", "int_med", "pie")])))
```

The natural direct effect is `cde + int_ref`, the natural indirect effect is
`int_med + pie`, and the four add to the total effect.

## Same result from the closed-form engine

`engine = "regmedint"` computes the same quantities from the closed-form
regression formulas, with analytical standard errors (needs the suggested
`regmedint` package).

```{r}
#| label: regmedint
#| eval: !expr requireNamespace("regmedint", quietly = TRUE)
fit_rm <- fit_mediation(
  outcome_int ~ treatment * mediator1 + covariate1 + covariate2,
  mediator1 ~ treatment + covariate1 + covariate2,
  data = mediation_demo, treatment = "treatment", mediator = "mediator1",
  engine = "regmedint"
)
all.equal(decompose(fit_rm), decompose(fit))
```

## Limits

- Only products written with `:` or `*` in the **outcome** model are
  recognized. A product precomputed as a data column cannot be seen and would be
  ignored, so write it in the formula.
- Non-Gaussian outcomes or mediators error; see
  [glm families](model-glm-families.html) for what is supported there.
- The native engine does not support the four-way decomposition (it estimates no
  mediator intercept).
